name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
label: Quest
description: The Wildlife Suffers Too: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While there was little I could do alone to thwart the Scourge, I nevertheless came to these lands to try and heal the damage done to nature. Animals suffer from the plague that continues to choke these lands, unable to find mercy and peace. I ask for you to continue what I could not finish here.

There is no salvation for the suffering animals but a sweet and merciful release. Seek out diseased wolves nearby and put them down. Please friend, end their misery - doing so will surely soothe mine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The wolves that are infected with the plague must be put down, friend. The disease they carry cannot be cured. I tried... I tried until I succumbed to the plague myself.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I... I sense that the souls of those wolves you have put down now have rest. They - and I - thank you for a merciful release.
The wolves are not alone in their suffering within this damnable place, friend. Please, I have need of you once more.
